articles.summary: For a leader at the Pentagon, unrefined data is like sand in the gears. Defense leaders today are overwhelmed by volume. When networks are clogged with raw information, the result is decision paralysis, leading to slower responses, poorer choices, and a loss of initiative.
articles.title: Applied AI for Decision Dominance:

articles.summary: In the modern operational environment, data is no longer a scarce resource; it is an overwhelming torrent. For military commanders, the challenge has shifted from finding information to filtering it. When senior leaders are inundated with competing reports, inconsistencies, and vast datasets, the result is often decision paralysis or worse, slower, poorer decision.
